comment: Nicest woman ever! Majority of class is lecture based, can get tedious, but not too hard.  Her tests are mostly short answers, kindof hard, but if you know the studies and terms you're golden.  She's always willing to help you.

Dr. Bagwell is hands down my favorite professor so far. She is incredibly nice, helpful and has a passion for what she teaches that makes it very easy to understand. She co-teachers intro to psych and her part of the class is the most informative and interesting. Her test is loaded with information, but her grading is very fair.
Bagwell's really chill, she's a good professor to go to if you need help with anything and she's always willing to give you extra help if you need it. Real good people.

Strange but cool class.  Bagwell co-teaches the class with Mayes and keeps everything on track. Lots of reading, but good guest speakers. Don´t miss too many classes and keep up with the readings and you´ll be fine.

She's great. Hands down my favorite professor at Richmond. She's so sweet and genuinely wants her students to do well. She specializes in Child Development so she would always treat us like kids and bring in cake and treats for us. She's always smiling and a great teacher. DEFINITELY try and get her as a teacher.
Very sweet disposition, always willing to help with additional info, explanation
no matter what you put into it you'll get a B, but the class is interesting and she's very helpful
